title: limonium tenellum
intro: Limonium tenellum, commonly known as dwarf sea lavender or sea lavender, is a flowering plant species native to coastal areas of Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, and may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Limonium tenellum include its ability to soothe skin irritations, reduce anxiety, and promote sleep. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
